subject: Commercial options: parity, soft credits, and pilot structure
messages:
From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@clearpath.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@clearpath.com
Date: 2025-09-10T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Commercial options for ClearPath inference footprint

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the demo last week — the performance looked promising. Our execs have asked for a concrete commercial comparison to our incumbent inference vendor. Two asks from procurement and finance: 1) can Redwood match or come within parity of our current blended unit economics (they've given me high-level numbers offline), and 2) what packaging/transition credits do you offer (pilot credits, egress assistance, or onboarding discount) if we move ~150k monthly inference units over a 6–9 month migration?

Attached is our RFI with usage mix and compliance checklist. We are sensitive to both headline unit price and the near-term go-live cost. Happy to jump on a short call but wanted to get an outline in writing first.

Cheers,
Hannah Li
Senior Sourcing Manager
ClearPath

Attachments: ClearPath_RFI_2025.pdf (PDF, 420 KB)
From: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@clearpath.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: 2025-09-10T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial options for ClearPath inference footprint

Hi Hannah —

Appreciate the RFI and the clarity on priorities. High level answer up front: we can get within parity on per-unit economics in steady state for your mix, and we have a few structuring levers to reduce near-term migration cost.

Options we'd propose to evaluate (short bullets so you can share internally):
- Pilot credit: $75k of platform credits applied to proof-of-value (60-day pilot) to offset integration/testing.
- Staged consumption credit: a declining credit applied over the first 3 billing months to smooth net cost during cutover.
- One-time onboarding/egress assistance: up to $25k engineering hours credit for runbook work or data egress assistance.
- Packaging: we can offer a 12-month consumption commitment at a blended discounted unit rate which reaches parity at ~9–12 months.

I'll loop in our pricing lead (Marissa) and the deal owner (Jordan) so we can surface a specific numerical offer after reviewing the usage attachments. Can you confirm whether you need an all-or-nothing migration (single go-live) or if a phased per-service migration is acceptable? That affects credits and bandwidth allocation.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Sales, Cloud Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Hi team — quick price sketch attached (redwood_soft_credit_options.xlsx). High-level recommendation below.

Recommended commercial package (conservative):
1) Pilot: $75k credit applied against first two invoices (60-day pilot).
2) Staged consumption credit: 40% credit month 1, 25% month 2, 10% month 3 (applied to consumed units).
3) Commitment pricing: 12-month commitment at a blended unit rate that is ~6% below their current headline; effective net price (after credits) reaches parity in month 4 for the stated usage profile.
4) One-time onboarding engineering credit: $20k (applied to professional services or egress cost).

Attachment contains two delta scenarios: (A) conservative concession (above), (B) stretch concession: increase pilot to $100k and bump staged credits by +10% to accelerate parity to month 3.

Risks / guardrails: any credit structure should include clearly defined acceptance criteria for pilot completion and a 45-day rollback window if migration stalls. Also recommend a clause that credits are payable only against Redwood invoices (no cash refunds) to keep accounting simple.

I'll mark up a term-sheet draft for Grace to send.

-Marissa
Director, Pricing and Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for the RFI and the fast turnaround time. After reviewing usage and our internal options, Redwood can offer the following to make the financials and go-live frictionless:

Offer summary (final):
- Pilot credit: $75,000 applied to the first two invoices (60-day pilot).
- Staged consumption credits: 40% (M1), 25% (M2), 10% (M3) applied to consumed units to reduce net spend during migration.
- One-time onboarding/egress engineering credit: $20,000 (applied to Redwood professional services or egress assistance).
- Commitment pricing: 12-month consumption commitment priced at a blended unit rate (details in attached term sheet) designed to reach effective parity with your incumbent by month 4 for the usage profile you shared.

Operational commitments: 2 SSEs for pilot support (up to 80 hours total), a named technical PM, and a migration runbook review within the first 14 days post-signature.

Conditions: credits are applied only to Redwood invoices and expire 6 months after initial invoice date. Pilot acceptance criteria will be mutual and documented prior to credit redemption.

I've attached a short term sheet and the HubSpot deal link. If this sounds acceptable, I'm happy to schedule a 30-minute procurement/finance call to walk through the numbers and DocuSign the term sheet.

Best regards,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Sales, Cloud Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
